name: Sable Luxe Atmospheric Veil
description:
A sheer, face-covering veil made from smart-fabric that can shift opacity, color, and pattern in response to the wearer's biometric state or manual input from a wrist controller. At full transparency, it is barely visible; at full opacity, it renders the wearer's face completely obscured behind flowing, organic patterns.

Exclusive to Tier 5 social events where anonymity is a luxury rather than a necessity. The Atmospheric Veil is as much performance art as fashion — each veil is programmed with a unique pattern library that its owner commissions from textile artists.
functionality: Variable opacity, pattern generation, biometric-responsive display
what_it_says: You can afford to make your face a canvas, and you choose who sees the real thing underneath.
story_hooks: An Atmospheric Veil at a Spire gala malfunctions, briefly displaying its wearer's true face — which belongs to someone who is supposed to be attending a different event on the other side of the city.
